extracted.name: Bokkeumbap
extracted.description: Try this quick Korean fried rice. Spam is often used as it seasons the rice and gets really nice and crispy when fried, but ham or bacon work too
ingredient_lines: 100g Spam finely chopped (or use ham or bacon)
1 small garlic clove minced or finely grated (about ¼ tsp)
instruction_lines: Whisk the eggs in a small bowl and set aside. Heat 1 tsp vegetable oil in a large frying pan over a high heat. Pour in the egg and, using tongs, move the it around the pan for 30 seconds or until just cooked. Remove the egg from the pan and set aside.

Heat the remaining 1 tbsp vegetable oil in the pan over high heat and fry the Spam for 2 mins until the edges are crispy. Add the carrot, spring onion and garlic to the pan and fry for 3 mins. Tip in the rice and soy sauce. Stir well, breaking up any large clumps of rice and fry for 2 mins until the rice and vegetables are completely mixed together. Stir in the eggs and sesame oil to serve.
